scope: Two independent local authenticated browser profiles; controlled provider API/asset helper and actual isolated compiler/render verifier. No live Cloudflare account or hosted acceptance.
checks: Exact frontend v1, source/output hashes and private files prepared with no account or inference.
Two independent participants can read private plans and retain independent Artifacts selection.
Verified account/project/unique preview branch is reviewable; membership alone grants no release authority.
Owner explicitly approves frozen public preview; one creation, live byte hashes and real isolated render pass.
Explicit owner grant requires a new approval-bound plan; second participant releases and observes durable results.
Second participant retrieves the exact saved immutable output through authenticated project access.
Recovery prepares a new unique preview plan reusing verified immutable bytes; no production rollback mutation.
Preview review and hashes fit a 390-pixel viewport.
Workflow, Canvas and token tracking remain unchanged; zero inference and only controlled provider operations.
